gizmo.title: Whakarewa utauta o waho
gizmo.description: He paraka e whakatuwhera ana i tētahi utauta ako o waho ki tētahi matapihi hou, ki te whārangi rānei, hei hono noa, me tētahi tono takiuru LTI 1.3 rānei.

configure.title: Taitara
configure.description: Te ingoa o te utauta. Ka whakaaturia ki te pane me te pātene.

configure.title: Whakaahuatanga
configure.description: Te mea ka mahia e ngā ākonga i te utauta, ka whakaaturia i runga ake i te pātene.

configure.title: URL whakarewa
configure.description: Te wāhitau o te utauta. Me wāhitau katoa e tīmata ana ki te https:// ki te http:// rānei.

configure.title: Whakatuwhera ki
configure.description: Ka mahi te matapihi hou ki ia utauta. Ko “I tēnei whārangi” ka mahi anake ki ngā utauta e whakaae ana kia whakaaturia ki roto i tētahi atu pae.

advanced.title: URL takiuru LTI
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 anake: te wāhitau tīmata takiuru o te utauta. Mā tēnei, he ID kiritaki me tētahi ID tuku, ka tuku te pātene i tētahi tono takiuru LTI, kaua e whakatuwhera i tētahi hono noa. Me whai te ratonga LTI o tēnei pae hei whakaoti i te whakarewatanga.

advanced.title: ID kiritaki LTI
advanced.description: Te ID kiritaki i hoatu e te utauta ki tēnei pae. He tautuhi tūmatanui, ehara i te muna: kaua rawa e tuku kī, muna rānei ki konei.

advanced.title: ID tuku LTI
advanced.description: Te ID tuku i hoatu e te utauta ki tēnei pae. He tautuhi tūmatanui, ehara i te muna.

advanced.title: Kaiwhakaputa LTI
advanced.description: Te wāhitau e tautohu ana i tēnei pae ki te utauta. Waiho kia wātea hei whakamahi i te wāhitau o te pae kei reira te whārangi.

advanced.title: Teitei i te whārangi
advanced.description: Te teitei o te utauta ina tuwhera i tēnei whārangi, i ngā pika (200 ki te 2000).

advanced.title: Tae arotahi
advanced.description: Te tae o te maramara pane me te pātene. Waiho kia wātea hei whai i te kaupapa.

developer.title: Tohu takiuru LTI
developer.description: He uara pūataata-kore e whakamahia ana e te ratonga LTI o tēnei pae hei mōhio ki te ākonga. I te nuinga o te wā ka tukuna e te pae mā te takahanga lti-launch-request, kaua e tiakina ki konei. Ehara rawa i te kupuhipa, i te kī rānei.

developer.title: Tohu karere LTI
developer.description: He uara pūataata-kore e whakamahia ana e te ratonga LTI o tēnei pae hei mōhio ki tēnei whakarewatanga. I te nuinga o te wā ka tukuna e te pae, kaua e tiakina ki konei.
